summary: M1 re-verified on tx (server 8, tx4c16g) for the Phase 1/2 hardening commit: the branch was built into talus-local:v0.9.0-test.4, deployed through dokploy, and the Hub served that version locally and publicly with a clean startup on real TimescaleDB. The new migration path was verified in both directions (an empty database bootstraps, writes the token-version marker once and asks for first-user setup; the existing database was not re-migrated), and the new REQ-05/REQ-07 code was exercised end-to-end on the deployed build (Relay standard/bounded_stream accepted, an unknown mode rejected with 400).

environment.build_note: the first build attempt failed in the alpine RUN step with a transient CDN 403 during apk add; the same apk command succeeded in a minimal build and the retry completed (cached layers). Container bridge egress to the TUN fake-ip range still times out, so RUN steps need --network=host.
